subject: Ledgerly onboarding: proposed billing split and early-remit options
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@ledgerly.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ledgerly Systems AP <ap@ledgerly.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ledgerly onboarding: billing cadence and early-pay options

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get Ledgerly set up in Redwood's vendor portal. Attached are our W-9 and a short supplier profile (supplier_onboarding_form.pdf). Before we complete the portal, wanted to align on two things so AP doesn't have follow-ups after PO creation:

- Our standard payment term is Net 60.
- We can accept a split billing cadence if Redwood prefers staggered invoices (example: 50/50 split at milestone + final).
- We can offer an early-remit discount for certain invoice bands (1.5% if paid within 15 days for invoices under $50k).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) issue a single PO that allows split invoices, and (b) whether your finance team would consider a small early-pay discount for the subset noted above? If needed I can attach a sample invoice showing the split.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Head of Finance Ops
Ledgerly Systems
attachments: W9_Ledgerly.pdf, supplier_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledgerly onboarding: billing cadence and early-pay options

Hi Asha — welcome, and thanks for sending the forms.

Short answers up front: we can issue a PO that allows split invoices; finance is generally amenable to short-window early-pay discounts, but we need to lock down the exact cadence and approvals. Marcus is cc'd to confirm tolerances and any threshold limits.

A couple of requests to speed this through:
- Can you attach a sample pair of invoices showing the split and the total contract value (so Marcus can run the quick cashflow math)?
- Please confirm the bank details on the supplier form match your ACH remit instructions.
- If you have a preferred invoice description line to match the PO (SOW or milestone IDs), include that.

Proposed approach from my side:
1) We accept a PO that permits up to two invoices per PO (milestone + final) for onboarding work.
2) Default Redwood payment term is Net 45 for new vendors; we can make Net 60 on a case-by-case basis with Finance approval.
3) If Ledgerly offers a 1.5% early-pay discount for payment <=15 days, Finance will evaluate for acceptance and thresholds.

Marcus — can you indicate whether Finance can accept Net 60 at first pass or whether we should suggest Net 45 with early-pay mechanics as the primary option?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledgerly onboarding: billing cadence and early-pay options

Hi Naomi / Asha — looping in finance perspective.

Key points from AP review:
- We can accept PO language that allows up to two invoices tied to milestones. Please ensure each invoice references the PO number and milestone ID so we can match during processing.
- Net 60 is fine for strategic vendors, but it requires a brief approval if the expected annual spend > $200k. Please confirm expected contract value.
- Early-pay discount: Finance is open to considering up to 2% for payments within 10–15 days, but acceptance will depend on effective annualized cost and whether the discount is applied to the full invoice or only a tranche.

Practical option we often use: staggered/remit plan where Redwood pays 60% of the invoice at Net 45 and the balance at Net 60 for larger engagements; smaller invoices (< $50k) can be flagged for 10–15 day early-remit if vendor offers >=1% discount.

Action items for Asha: please send sample invoice(s) showing the split and confirm anticipated quarterly spend bucket (est annual run rate). Also, please complete the supplier_onboarding_form.pdf and reattach bank/ACH fields. Once received, Monica will create the vendor record and issue the draft PO for signature.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Patel <asha@ledgerly.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ledgerly Systems AP <ap@ledgerly.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledgerly onboarding: billing cadence and early-pay options

Thanks Marcus — attaching sample_invoice.pdf showing a 40/60 split (40% milestone, 60% final) and a short table with expected quarterly spend. Our anticipated ARR for Redwood is ~$320k in year one.

We can do the following, if Redwood prefers a clearer path: 
- Option A (preferred by Ledgerly): Net 60 on full amount + 1.5% discount if paid within 15 days for invoices <$50k.
- Option B (compromise): Split PO (40% at invoice 1 / 60% at invoice 2). Redwood pays first invoice Net 45, final invoice Net 60. If Redwood chooses early-pay on either tranche, we apply 1.25% discount for payments <=15 days.

We completed the supplier_onboarding_form.pdf and confirmed ACH instructions. Please confirm whether Redwood needs any additional tax or corporate documentation before issuing the PO.

Best,
Asha
Head of Finance Ops, Ledgerly Systems
attachments: sample_invoice.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ledgerly onboarding: billing cadence and early-pay options

Asha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample invoice. This is helpful.

Decision and next steps:
- Finance will provisionally approve Option B (40/60 split with Net 45 / Net 60 cadence). We will accept 1.25% early-pay discount for payments <=15 days on either tranche, applied only if Redwood elects early payment in AP workflow.
- Because expected ARR is ~ $320k, Marcus confirmed we do not need an executive exception to allow Net 60 on the final tranche, but we will note the vendor flag as "Net60/early-pay eligible" in our vendor record.
- Monica will generate the vendor record and issue draft_PO_Redwood_12345.pdf (attached) for signature. PO will include a clause: "Allows up to two invoices per PO; early-pay discount as agreed upon and applied at AP discretion."

Please sign the supplier form if you haven't already; Monica will follow up with the DocuSign link and the PO. Once PO is signed, AP will confirm expected payment windows for the first two invoices.

Thanks and welcome aboard — looking forward to working together.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
